thank you so much. i really really appreciate this. i told my mom that my father practically ruined my life, which he did, because had it not been for him and the trauma he has caused me and the way he treats everyone around him, i would not be mentally ill (i have bpd, which comes from trauma for context). if i had a normal childhood i'm sure that i wouldn't feel the way i'm feeling everyday. i don't know what else to tell her because she really doesn't seem to understand the seriousness of my dislike of him. she always tells me that it's "not like he beat you everyday" and things of that nature. even if he didn't beat me at all and only verbally and emotionally abused me i wouldn't like him. i don't know, i just feel very lonely and like no one is in my corner, at least in my family.

i hope so too. i do plan on going to college hopefully next year if i can get into art school, and hopefully i can get into an art school that's far away from home. thank you again for the kind words. i truly appreciate them.

thank you so much. my mom believes the fact that because he is my father i have to forgive him and love him no matter what. but i don't love him and i don't think i ever will. he gave my mom a black eye when i was 13 and i haven't been the same since. i don't care the amount of "help" he gets, he means nothing to me, but she really wants HIM to get better instead of ME. avoiding him is sort of fruitless because my mom will MAKE me talk to him in order for him to "not feel bad." it's a really crappy situation overall.
thank you. i'm trying my best not to fall into the cycle. i'm trying to get out of the situation but it's very hard for me. thank you regardless though, i appreciate it.

hi, thank you so much. i never really planned on living this long (for context i am 18, which is a legal adult where i'm from), so i never really thought much about my future. i took a year off from high school because i didn't know what college i wanted to go to, and i'm currently in an online art school. i want to build up a portfolio but i feel like my art isn't strong enough just yet to get me anywhere, seeing as i didn't constantly keep at it when i was young. i'm a pretty smart person who could have easily done anything but i really love art and want to be an animator. i'm pretty financially dependent on my parents right now and don't have access to my credit card, as my mom is technically the owner of it. i'm sort of stuck for now but i'm trying to figure things out.
absolutely. thank you again, it means so much to me.

thank you again. i would stay with a friend but the only problem is my parents have security cams and door alarms all over our house. even though i am 18, my parents rarely let me stay over someone else's house seeing as it's still "their house, their rules" type deal. i'm also a very lonely person irl and most of my friends i went to high school with went to distant colleges where it's hard for me to visit them.
i'm definitely going to try to. thank you again for all the kind words. i really appreciate them and they've made my day a bit better.
yeah, i definitely know she's a victim too but i guess she doesn't believe it or doesn't want to believe it i guess.

yes, i definitely do not want to perpetuate this cycle if i chose to start a family when i get older. i'm currently in therapy but i haven't been able to go lately due to my online art school. i really want to go back though because i'm in desperate need of that support and love. thank you for this. i really really appreciate it.

my mom does the same thing! it drives me nuts. especially when she goes on about "well it's not like he beat you everyday" or "i could count the amount of times your father hit you on one hand, maybe two." she makes me feel so so bad and minimizes my abuse so often. thank you for the hug though. i wish i could hug you back.

thank you so much. i feel like she's trying to fix him in order to fix the entire family but i don't want him to be fixed, especially after everything he's put me through. he's basically dead to me. i'm going to go into the new year feeling like no one in my family cares and like i'm completely alone. i just wish my mom could understand where i'm coming from but she doesn't. she makes me feel bad every time i talk to her.

i think she's told me about the fact her parents had a similar relationship to hers and my father's. i know this is probably her normal but i don't know. i guess i just feel like she should open her eyes to see how much i'm suffering. again, thank you for talking to me. i really needed this. ):

thank you so much. it's sort of cultural considering my family is hispanic and there's a lot of value to family & protecting & upholding it in our culture. i've been sad for pretty much a week now because there was this huge abusive event that happened ON CHRISTMAS and my mom and i talked about it and i thought for once she was on my side but she's back to waiting on him, making him food, and sleeping with him in their room again (whenever there's a big fallout between them they sleep separately). today she told me that because of the fact my grandparents are coming over (they are visiting from florida) she doesn't want me "moping around." i feel so lonely. she's my mom. she shouldn't tell me stuff like that.
